content: Ester rey-omega sulesad
We-ibmar-gusad-sorbali, Rey-Asuero na sae-itodiid baisur-itogusadgine, e-ome-Vasti ebinsaalid, igi e-omede neg-imaksagusa, degi, igi e-omega igar megis gusbali.
Geb degine, Rey-Asuero-bendakdimalad, degi, e-dule-dummagan sogdemalad: “Reyga yagan-yoo-sui-nikumalad yeerdaklemalad aminamala.

Rey-Asuero, bela be-yar-dakmaidgine, bela-neggwebur-iliba be dulemar-onugsae, adi, wemala yagan-yoo-sui-nikumalad-yeerdaklemalad Susa-neggweburse, rey-omegan-negmar-siidse sedamalagar. Geb a-neggine, Hegai we-yagan-akoed. Hegaiʼde, bur-rey-walikagwadid, rey-omegan-edarbedid. Geb Hegai, we-yaganga yeerdaklegega-wagargi-ibmar-maglemalad ukoed.
Geb rey, yagwa-bur-yeerdakleged, Vasti-anar e-omega suoed.” Weyob-soglesadi, Rey-Asuero yeer-itosad. Geb deyob ibmar-imakmalaga igar uksad.
Ester reynegse nonikid
Susa-neggweburgi, reyneg-siidgine, Judío-dule-wargwen, Jair-machi-Mardoqueoʼye-nugad gudiid. Jairʼde, Simei-e-machid. Simeiʼdi, Quis-e-machid. Quisʼdi, dad-dummad-Benjamínʼgi danikid.
Mardoqueo dulemar-galesgusmaladba Jerusalén-neggweburgi seleargusad. We-dulemar, Judá-e-rey-Jeconíasʼmala Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosorʼse gales selesgusmalad.

Mardoqueo, e-sia-wargwen na e-ibe-sergan-burgwisad odungusad. E-babgan-burgwisgua, Mardoqueo na-e-bunoloyob susad. We-yagwa Hadasaʼye-nugad, deginbali, Esterʼye nugbalid. Ester bunagwa-nued-itoged, bela-bela yeerdakleged.

Rey-igar-mesisad wisgusmargua, yagan-bukidar Susa-neggweburse, reynegse selenonimalad. Agi, Hegai we-yagan-akwenonikid. Ester, we-yagan-abargine reynegse selenonimogad. Agi Hegai. Ester-akwisad. Hegaiʼde, rey-e-omegan-edarbedga gudiid.

Hegai, Ester-yeerdaksad, degi, nued daksabalid. A-ulale, Hegai, Esterʼga yeerdaklegega-wagargi-ibmar-maglemalad yoga-ukar imaksad. Bur mas-nuegan ega uksabalid. Deginbali, Hegai Esterʼga-ibmar-imakmalaga reyneggi-yagan-bur-nuegan-gudidiid walagugle (7) uksabalid. Geb Ester we-yagan-walagugledmala (7) rey-e-omegan-neg-bur-nuedse selesad.
Ester na sogsasulid ede bialidi, degi, doamar e-gwenadgan gubali. Ar ade, Mardoqueo ega sogsagusad: “Melle be-dulemargi, degi, be-sergangi be sunmakoye.”
Mardoqueoʼdi, bane-bane rey-e-omegan-neg-bukwad-asabin nasdaed. Adi, na wisguega, Ester nued gudiidibeye, igi imakdimardibeye.

Yagan reyse-daged-iduale, birgagwen igar-maidba yeerdaklegega-ibmar-ebulemalad magdidii gumaloed. Nii-walanergwa (6) sapi-mirra-e-gwalluginbi abagan-magdii gumaloed. Geb baid nii-walanergwa (6), gwallu-wawadikmalad-bur-yeer-yapanmaladgi, degi, ina-wawadikmalad-bur-nuegangi abagan-magdii gumarbaloed. Geb a-ibamar-sorbali, we-yagan war-wargwen Rey-Asueroʼse nonimaloed.
Yagwa-wargwen reyse dagsokalile, bela rey-e-omegan-neggi ibmar-sedbied ega ukledaed. Geb we-ibmar-yoi reynegse naddamalad.

Neg-sedogusale, yagan war-wargwen reynegse naddamalad. Geb banedgine, omegan neg-baidsik barmilesdaed. A-neggi, Saasgaz neg-akwediid. Ar we-dulede, a-neggi rey-omegan edarbediid. Geb a-sorbali, we-omegan bar gannar reyse nonisurdamalad. Ar rey na biti-ome-wargwen gannar dakbierdi, degi, ese gornamalaga imaksale, unnila aginbi a-ome gannar reyse nonidaed.

Mardoqueo-e-gilor-Abihail-e-sisgwa-Esterʼga, Rey-Asueroʼse naed-e-ibagan-warmaknonigua, rey-omegan-edarbed-Hegai, ibi ibmar-ese-egisoye ega sogsagusa, unnila a-ibmarbi Ester, Hegaiʼse egichisad. Bela dulemar Ester-walik-gudimaladi yeer Ester-dakmalad.
Rey-Asuero birgaguglegus reyga-maidgi, a-nii-ambe-gwichidgi, Ester, rey-asabin-gwisgunaega reynegse selesad. A-nii Tebetʼye-bilebalid.
Rey-Asuero, omegan-bamaladba bur bela-bela Ester-abesad. Yagan-bamaladba bur Esterʼbina nue-soge itosad. Degisoggu, Rey-Asuero, Ester-nonogi ologurgin sisad, geb Vasti-anar Rey-omega Ester-sunonikid.

Geb sorbali, Rey-Asuero e-dummagan-negdakmamaidga, degi, ega arbamaladga, Ester-nuggi iba-dummad onosad. Rey-Asuero bela e-yarmar-dakmaidgi mani-uklegergebed bipi-imaksad. Deginbali, rey na yeer-itogedba ibmarmar obinebaka binsa-uknai gusbalid.
Rey-Asuero-oburgwega igar-amismalad
Yagan-suisurmalad gannar rey-omegan-negse selenonimargua, Mardoqueoʼdi, reyneg-yawagakgi neg-daksii gusad.
Ester, Mardoqueo ega igar-uksadba sogsasulid doamar e-sergana, degi, ede bialidbali. Ar Ester, Mardoqueo-walik-gudiunni igi eba ibsadae, deyobi, Mardoqueo-sogedba ibmar imaksad.

Mardoqueo reyneg-yawagak-naba-sigu, Bigtán, degi, Teres sunmake itoalid. We-dulemardi, dummagan-warbogwad reyneg-yawagakgi-nakulemaladid. We-dulemar nue-sae-itogedgine, Rey-Asuero-oburgwega igar-aminanaid.
Mardoqueo we-dulemar weyob sunmaknai itosgu, Rey-ome-Esterʼga we-gayaburba ogwasad. Agine, Esterʼmoga Mardoqueo-nuggi reyga we-gayaburba ogwasmogad.

A-ulale, Rey-Asuero we-gayaburba-baraminai gualid, wede bule nabiri. Geb baramisgu, daklealid, we-gayaburba nue-napiragwa. Degisoggu, we-dule-ebogwad-dummagan dukargi-galegar burgwismalad. Geb bela we-ibmar-gusadi, rey-wagab rey-gardamargi narmakles megisad.
